body.name: \(B_\pi\)
body.construction: For each \(a\in M\), \(k\in\{1,\ldots,p\}\), and \(A_{k-1}=\{\pi(1),\ldots,\pi(k-1)\}\), set \(B_\pi^{(a)}[\pi(k),A_{k-1}]=\Sigma^{aa}[\pi(k),A_{k-1}]\{\Sigma^{aa}[A_{k-1},A_{k-1}]\}^{-1}\), set all other entries of that row to zero, and set \(L_\pi^{(a)}=I_p-B_\pi^{(a)}\).
